characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

At step 5 of the Round of Combat Sequence (after issuing and accepting Duels), the model must use one of the following fighting techniques and apply its effects until the end of the Round of Combat.
  • Drawing the Void: Aegis (+1).
  • Ritual of Steel: +2 Armour Penetration with Close Combat Attacks.
  • A single Moment: +1 to wound with Close Combat Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Unless another friendly Daimyo does so first, a Kensai must issue or accept Duels whenever possible.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Enemy models in units in Base Contact with one or more Kitsune suffer -1 Offensive Skill, -1 Defensive Skill and -1 Agility.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Friendly units in 8" gain Aegis (5+, against Ranged Attacks). Additionally, the model may cast Spectral Blades (Evocation) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains War Platform, Exclusive (Scoring and Infantry), Attached, and changes its Base to 60~mm. Additionally, models in the same unit as the War Shrine gain Lethal Strike and Fight in Extra Rank.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model cannot benefit from Commanding Presence or Rally Around the Flag.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model loses Devastating Charge (+1 Att) and Scoring, and gains Light Armour, Longbow (3+), Feigned Flight, Vanguard (12") and Light Troops.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Cannon. Range 48", Shots 1, Str 3 [7], AP 0 [10], Area Attack (1×5) [Multiple Wounds (D3)], Flaming Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

Catapult (4×4), Range 12--48", Shots 1, Str 4, AP, Flaming Attacks. The model changes its Height to Large.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute -- Shooting

The Shooting Attack gains Shots 2.Additionally, when shooting from Short Range, the attack gains +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model can cast the following Spells from Cosmology as Bound Spells with Power Level (4/8). These spells can only target the Yamabushi's unit or enemy units in base contact with the Yamabushi.
  • Truth of Time
  • Perception of Strength
  • Unity in Divergence

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

All models in a unit containing one or more models with this rule gain +1 Agility.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Discipline Tests taken by the target are subject to Minimised Roll for the first Break Test

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Dispelling rolls from your opponent against Augment Spells suffer a -1 modifier if more than half of the models affected by the Spell have this rule. This also affects Bound Spells.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Each side with one or more units with Sashimonos and at least one Full Rank adds +1 to its Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Hand Weapon. Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Offensive Skill, +1 Strength and ignore Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots: 2, Strength 3, Armour Penetration 0, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains +1 Resilience against Ranged Attacks. This has no effect on Flaming Attacks or Toxic Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Kensai cannot join units that contain another Kensai. Unless another model does so first, a Kensai must issue a Duel.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model's Poison Attacks wound automatically on a successful to-hit roll of 5+ instead of 6+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the model touches a Water Terrain feature at the beginning of any of its movements, it can choose to gain Fly (7", 14") until the end of the Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model loses Scoring and gains Hard Target (1), Light Troops and Skirmisher.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If this unit has at least two full ranks it can choose to use this rule in the Shooting Phase. If it does, only models in the first rank can shoot and any unit shot at by this unit must take a Discipline Test with -1 for each Full Rank after the first of the shooting unit (to a maximum of -3). If this test is failed, the unit cannot perform a March Move in its next Player Turn. Units that automatically pass Panic Tests are unaffected by this rule.\

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The War Fan always counts as a Shield against Ranged Attacks (and can be used differently depending on the chosen Dance, see Kabuki Dance).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model must choose one of the two dances to perform at step 2 of the Round of Combat Sequence and apply its effects until the end of the Round of Combat. All Kabuki Dolls in the unit must choose the same dance:

  • Jidaimono: +1 Armour Penetration. The War Fan counts as Paired Weapons with this dance.
  • Sewamono: Distracting. The War Fan counts as a Shield with this dance.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Before shooting, the model may choose to gain Flaming Attacks for its Shooting Attack. The effect lasts for the duration of the phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Models with this Mon gain Quick to Fire and Shoot in Extra Rank.\
The Longbow of a Daimyo with this Mon gains Shots 3.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Infantry only.

Models with this Mon gain Distracting in the first Round of each Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Warrior Monks and Yamabushi with this Mon gain Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks).\
Each Yamabushi, Shugenja and Mikoshi Shrine with this Mon generates a Veil Token at the beginning of the game and allows storing an additional Veil Token at the end of Siphon the Veil (up to a maximum of 6 Veil Tokens).\Divination=divination

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Models with this Mon may re-roll failed Ambush rolls, and gain Hatred and Vanguard.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Cannot be taken by Infantry models.

Model parts with this Mon and with Kenjutsu (X) gain Devastating Charge (Kenjutsu (2)). Additionally, Units with all of their models with this Mon must reroll any natural rolls of ‘1’
when rolling for Charge Range.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For every X successful to-hit rolls against the same Health Pool, an additional hit is caused. Count seperately for each Character and each Initiative Step. While fighting in a Duel, the model part decreases the value of~X by~1 until the Duel ends (i.e. a Model with Kenjutsu (3) effectively has Kenjutsu (2) while fighting in a Duel). If a model has multiple instances of Kenjutsu (X), use the one with the lowest value for~X.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Hand Weapon. Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Offensive Skill, +1 Strength and ignore Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots: 2, Strength 3, Armour Penetration 0, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains +1 Resilience against Ranged Attacks. This has no effect on Flaming Attacks or Toxic Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This spell may only target Characters, Champions, and single model units. Choose two different combinations of Model Part and non-global characteristic (except Armour). Choose these characteristics prior to making a Casting Attempt. Each chosen model part gets +1 to the chosen characteristic. {Your opponent cannot refuse Duels issued by the target.}

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The wielder always shoots before all other models in his unit. For every successful to-hit roll of attacks with this weapon, choose one of the following Attack Attributes (Shooting), which apply to all other friendly models making Shooting Attacks with a Longbow against the target unit in this phase:

  • Natural to-hit rolls of ‘1’ must be rerolled.
  • Natural to-wound rolls of ‘1’ must be rerolled.
  • The Armour Penetration of the attack is \ set to 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength, +2 Armour Penetration and Lightning Reflexes.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Armour Penetration. Additionally, the bearer gains Kenjutsu (2).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration. If the wielder causes one or more unsaved wounds with this weapon while charging, all models in the target unit suffer -1 to-hit until the end of the Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour. Melee Attacks can never wound the bearer on better than 4+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Fear and enemy units cannot choose Stand and Shoot as a Charge Reaction when reacting to Charges made by the bearer’s unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour. In addition, the wearer can always make an Armour Save against enemy attacks; his Armour Save succeeds at least on a roll of 5+ (independent of the Armour Penetration of the Attack).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
R&F Models in the bearer's unit gain Lightning Reflexes in
the First Round of Combat. Model Parts with Harnessed are not affected.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. Must be activated when the bearer's model suffers its first wound in the game after Armour Saves. The bearer’s model gains Aegis (2+) against this wound.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: A single Casting Attempt with 3 or more Magic Dice performed by the bearer can be subject to Maximised Role in each Magic Phase. Declare using this item before rolling any dice.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. This item can be used at the beginning of any phase and lasts until the end of the Player Turn. The bearer's unit gains +4" March Rate, Swiftstride, Ghost Step and Strider. No models can join or leave the unit until the effect ends.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Directly after choosing Spells, the bearer selects one of his own Spells. All Casting Attempts of this Spell with 2 or more Dice performed by the bearer are subject to Maximised Role.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Duels issued by the model must (if possible) be accepted by an enemy Character, unless a Champion accepts first. The bearer’s model can score up to +4 Overkill Combat Score instead of +3.
